findings.claim: The accept click now runs on candidate nodes captured during the single-pass scan instead of a fresh tree walk started after policy evaluation, widening the acquisition-to-click window from about zero to the duration of parsing, policy evaluation and logging. If the popup node is detached or recycled by the system during that interval, performAction returns false and this event auto-accept is skipped and retried on the next accessibility event. Failure mode is benign: no crash, no click on a wrong view, at most a delayed acceptance.
